polls.description: Growing tensions over AI chip exports to China as governments impose restrictions and seize shipments amid the global race for AI hardware dominance.
polls.question: Are AI chip export controls protecting security or hindering progress?

cluster_stories.title: US investigated Chinese spy plot aimed at Nvidia CEO
cluster_stories.summary: A top executive of a Singapore AI cloud company that was accused of illegally selling Nvidia chips to China could also have been a Chinese spy, sources have told the New York Times.
cluster_stories.headline: US PROBED CHINESE SPY PLOT Targeting Nvidia CEO

cluster_stories.title: Malaysia intercepted $12.2 million shipment of servers with AI chips suspected of violating export controls
cluster_stories.summary: Malaysia introduced permit requirements for shipping AI chips of U.S. origin last year, under pressure from the U.S. to prevent rerouting to China
cluster_stories.headline: Malaysia Seizes $12.2M AI Chip Shipment... Export Control Violation Suspected

cluster_stories.title: Indian AI Firm Seeks $3 Billion Financing for Nvidia Chips Order
cluster_stories.summary: Indian AI infrastructure firm AM Intelligence is seeking to raise as much as $3 billion to fund a previously announced purchase of Nvidia Corp.’s next-generation chips, according to people familiar with the matter, the latest sign that the technology’s boom is driving a debt binge.
cluster_stories.headline: INDIAN AI FIRM SEEKS $3B TO FUND NVIDIA CHIP ORDER

cluster_stories.title: China's new export curbs draw a line around its AI crown jewels
cluster_stories.summary: The draft rules, released on October 16, distinguish between foreign customers using Chinese AI services and foreign companies obtaining the models, data or expertise needed to operate or reproduce them independently.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA DRAWS LINE Around AI Crown Jewels With Export Curbs

cluster_stories.title: US DOJ is inquiring about Nvidia's purchase of Hugging Face
cluster_stories.summary: The Justice Department's recent questioning covers Nvidia's acquisitions, investments, sales practices, and whether the chip designer has exerted pressure on its customers, the two people said.
cluster_stories.headline: DOJ PROBES Nvidia's Hugging Face Purchase

cluster_stories.title: China’s CXMT will make AI memory despite yields as low as 20%, Reuters says
cluster_stories.summary: China’s biggest memory chipmaker, CXMT, plans to start making HBM3E, an advanced memory used in AI chips, even though only 20% to 30% of the chips it makes are usable. Two people familiar with the matter told Reuters, which reported the details on Wednesday, 28 October. TNW has not independently verified the report. CXMT has […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: China's CXMT to Make AI Memory Despite 20% Yields

cluster_stories.headline: GENIE 4 RELEASED: DeepMind's Next-Gen World Simulator

cluster_stories.title: Alphabet shares fall 12% after Google says AI Mode searches earn less
cluster_stories.summary: By 9:35am in New York on Thursday, Alphabet had lost $511bn in market value, Julia Love and Davey Alba reported for Bloomberg. The shares were down more than 12%. It was the company’s biggest market value loss on record. A close more than 9.77% lower would be Alphabet’s worst reaction to results since its 2004 […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: GOOGLE LOSES $511B: AI Mode Searches Earn LESS

cluster_stories.title: Google Erases a Record $500 Billion as AI Eats Into Sales
cluster_stories.summary: Alphabet Inc.’s shares fell more than 13%, erasing more than $500 billion in its biggest-ever market plunge, after the company reported disappointing search and advertising sales that reinforced investor concerns about AI’s threat to its core business. Bloomberg's Mandeep Singh joins to discuss this as well as the possible Marvell and Lumentum Holdings deal as well as DoorDash buying Instacart. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: GOOGLE ERASES $500B IN SINGLE DAY... AI BACKFIRE

cluster_stories.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon with a ‘significant leap’ in cybersecurity
cluster_stories.summary: Google has released its latest frontier model, Gemini 4 Carbon, offering "significant gains" in coding, agentic tasks, and cybersecurity. In an announcement on Wednesday, Google highlights Carbon's top spot on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (v5.0) benchmark, with Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra trailing behind. The new Gemini 4 Carbon model offers improvements over […]
cluster_stories.headline: GOOGLE LAUNCHES GEMINI 4 CARBON: Major Leap in Cybersecurity

cluster_stories.title: Alphabet’s AI commitments pass $1tn, its quarterly filing shows
cluster_stories.summary: Alphabet’s quarterly filing, published on Thursday, puts its future payments for computing, energy and data centres at more than $1tn. These Alphabet commitments do not appear on its balance sheet, the filing says. Davey Alba reported the figures for Bloomberg. Chief financial officer Anat Ashkenazi had given the $1tn-plus total on Wednesday’s earnings call, Bloomberg […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: ALPHABET'S AI SPENDING HITS $1 TRILLION

cluster_stories.title: Google’s Genie 4 world model adds audio, more realistic worlds, and real-time steering
cluster_stories.summary: Google DeepMind released Genie 4, a world model with real-time audio, more realistic simulations, and mid-simulation text prompts, in research preview for trusted testers.
cluster_stories.headline: Google's Genie 4 World Model Adds Real-Time Audio & Steering
